title: Gold Team Snapshot
description: One JSON Lines entry per Gold Team / mock-evaluation run, appended to reviews/gold-team-history.jsonl. Append-only: never rewrite or delete prior lines. The accumulated series is what scripts/compute-lift.py turns into the discipline-lift metric (baseline-to-current pWin convergence and falling edit ratio).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the review run

mode.description: The red-team-review mode that produced the scorecard (e.g., 'mock-eval', 'red', 'full', 'lightweight')

pwin.description: The run's pWin estimate. Null for lightweight reader-response passes that do not score.

factor_ratings.description: Per-factor adjectival ratings from the scorecard summary table

draft_word_count.description: Total words across drafts/*.md (top level, excluding loose/) at review time

unsupported_claim_count.description: CLAIM-UNSUPPORTED markers across drafts/*.md at review time
